NEET UG 2026 Results Declared, Top Scorers and Pass Statistics Released

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has announced the results for the NEET UG 2026 examination. Two students, Aryan Gupta and Panshul Bansal, have achieved top ranks, scoring 715 out of 720 marks. The results indicate that over 11 lakh candidates have passed the examination, with 138 candidates scoring above 690. The NTA has also released the final answer key, dropping four questions from the exam.
